simple.prompt: By next November, I ___ at this firm for exactly ten years.
simple.explanation: Future Perfect Continuous (will have been + V-ing) mengukur durasi suatu aktivitas hingga titik tertentu di masa depan.
hints: Menghitung durasi hingga waktu masa depan (by next November).

simple.prompt: This time tomorrow, we ___ over the Atlantic on our flight to London.
simple.explanation: Future Continuous (will be + V-ing) menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu spesifik di masa depan.
hints: Aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa depan.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Perfect dengan 'by 5 p.m.'.
simple.targetSentence: She will have completed the report by 5 p.m.
simple.explanation: Subject + will have completed (selesai) + the report + by 5 p.m.
hints: Gunakan 'will have completed the report by 5 p.m.'.

simple.prompt: By the end of this semester, students ___ thirty academic essays.
simple.explanation: Untuk jumlah pencapaian/output terselesaikan di masa depan (thirty essays), gunakan Future Perfect Simple ('will have submitted').
hints: Menyatakan jumlah hasil yang sudah rampung.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Continuous untuk agenda rutin.
simple.targetSentence: I will be attending the regional conference next Friday.
simple.explanation: I will be attending + the regional conference + next Friday.
hints: Gunakan 'I will be attending the regional conference next Friday'.

simple.prompt: Don't phone at 8 p.m. because we ___ dinner with our clients.
simple.explanation: Aksi yang diprediksi sedang berlangsung saat itu ('will be having dinner').
hints: Sedang berlangsung di masa depan saat dihubungi.

simple.targetSentence: In June they will have been married for twenty years.
simple.explanation: In June (time marker) + they will have been married / living for twenty years.
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'they will have been married for twenty years'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih tenses yang sopan untuk menanyakan agenda orang lain tanpa memaksa.
dialogue: Excuse me, Dr. Miller, ___ the laser printer this afternoon?
No, go right ahead and print your batch.
intermediate.explanation: Future Continuous ('will you be using...?') digunakan sebagai bentuk bertanya yang sangat sopan (polite inquiry) mengenai rencana seseorang tanpa terkesan menuntut.
hints: Pertanyaan sopan mengenai agenda yang sudah terjadwal.

intermediate.prompt: Stative verb with future milestone: 'By next year, he ___ this vintage automobile for three decades.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Own' adalah kata kerja stative, sehingga tidak boleh menggunakan bentuk continuous. Wajib Future Perfect Simple: 'will have owned'.

intermediate.prompt: Time clauses with Present Simple: 'By the time you ___, we will have prepared the conference room.'
intermediate.explanation: Dalam klausa waktu (time clause) seperti 'by the time / when / as soon as', gunakan Present Simple ('arrive'), bukan future form.
hints: Klausa waktu 'by the time' menggunakan Present Simple.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Future Perfect dengan klausa waktu.
intermediate.targetSentence: We will have left before you reach the station.
intermediate.explanation: We will have left (Future Perfect) + before you reach the station (Present Simple).
hints: Klausa waktu: 'before you reach the station'.

intermediate.prompt: Milestone duration: 'By midnight, the marathon runner ___ for twelve consecutive hours.'
intermediate.explanation: Menekankan durasi aktivitas fisik yang berkelanjutan hingga batas waktu tengah malam ('will have been running').
hints: Durasi terus menerus hingga batas waktu.

intermediate.prompt: Susun pertanyaan Future Continuous yang sopan.
intermediate.targetSentence: Will you be driving to the office tomorrow morning?
intermediate.explanation: Will you be driving + to the office + tomorrow morning?
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'to the office tomorrow morning?'.

dialogue: Will the satellite reach orbit by dawn?
Yes, it ___ in orbit for an hour before the solar panels deploy.
intermediate.explanation: Menjelaskan perjalanan duratif sebelum aksi panel surya terbuka ('will have been traveling').

complex.prompt: Perbaiki penggunaan 'will' di dalam klausa waktu bersyarat waktu depan.
complex.draft: By the time the new regulations will take effect, we will have updated our software.
options: By the time the new regulations take effect, we will have updated our software.
By the time the new regulations will have taken effect, we will update our software.
By the time the new regulations took effect, we will have updated our software.
complex.explanation: Klausa waktu 'by the time...' tidak boleh memakai modal 'will'. Gunakan Present Simple ('take effect').

complex.prompt: Evaluate the semantic distinction: (1) 'I will meet the CEO' vs (2) 'I will be meeting the CEO'.
options: (1) expresses decision/intention; (2) expresses an arrangement as part of regular routine without fresh decision.
complex.explanation: 'Will be meeting' menyatakan bahwa pertemuan tersebut terjadi secara wajar/terjadwal sebagai bagian dari rutinitas atau agenda tanpa niat mendadak.
hints: Future Continuous menunjukkan hal yang terjadi secara wajar/terjadwal.

complex.prompt: By the time the treaty is ratified next spring, the delegations ___ for thirty-six months.
complex.explanation: Durasi negosiasi diplomasi yang terus berlanjut hingga ratifikasi tahun depan ('will have been negotiating').

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat analisis proyeksi finansial kuartal empat.
complex.targetSentence: By December the company will have achieved all its quarterly targets.
complex.explanation: By December + the company will have achieved + all its quarterly targets.
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'the company will have achieved all its quarterly targets'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan bentuk kata kerja stative pada klausa masa depan.
complex.draft: By 2030, our organization will have been possessing this patent for twenty years.
options: By 2030, our organization will have possessed this patent for twenty years.
By 2030, our organization will possess this patent for twenty years.
By 2030, our organization will be possessing this patent for twenty years.
complex.explanation: 'Possess' adalah kata kerja stative (kepemilikan), tidak boleh dalam bentuk continuous. Gunakan Future Perfect Simple: 'will have possessed'.

complex.prompt: Predicting present continuous action: 'Look at the time! Professor Evans ___ papers in his study right now.'
complex.explanation: Modal 'will be + V-ing' dapat digunakan untuk membuat deduksi/prediksi tentang apa yang kemungkinan besar sedang berlangsung saat ini ('will be grading').
hints: Deduksi aksi yang diasumsikan sedang berlangsung sekarang.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog konfirmasi jadwal audit eksternal.
dialogue: Can we schedule the briefing on Thursday afternoon?
The independent auditors ___ our books all afternoon, so Friday morning would be far better.
complex.explanation: Menjelaskan aktivitas yang dijadwalkan berlangsung sepanjang sore hari Kamis ('will be reviewing').
hints: Aktivitas yang akan sedang berlangsung terjadwal.
